Jack Edwards Reserve is an Australian soccer ground in Oakleigh, a suburb of Melbourne, Victoria. It is the home of Oakleigh Cannons. The ground has a single main stand with seating for approximately 500 patrons. An additional 500-seat grandstand, located at the opposite end of the pitch to the older stand, will be completed by September 2025 as part of a $14.7 million upgrade of the reserve. Jack Edwards Reserve has a capacity of 4,000.
The ground is situated at 22 Edward Street, Oakleigh and is the site of football matches for the Oakleigh's senior men's, women's and junior teams, in the National Premier Leagues and Australia Cup.
